event: 43 Copa del Rey MAPFRE - ORC European Championship
procedural_matters: POR 25682 was represented by Pedro Andrade (helm).
ITA 4149 did not come to the hearing when the hearing began at 1745, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
The representative of ITA 4149 joined the hearing at 1750. ITA 4149 was represented by Marco Corno (helm)
Carmen Navarro (crew member of ESP 36940) presented video evidence and gave evidence as a witness for POR 25682.
facts: POR 25682 is 31 feet long, ITA 4149 is 41 feet long.
The conditions at the time of the incident on the second upwind in race 8 for ORC B were 12 knots of wind and small chop.
POR 25682 and ITA 4149 were sailing close-hauled on port tack on the port layline to mark 1b at a distance of approximately 100 m from the mark.
ITA 4149, who was initially clear astern and to windward of POR 25682, was sailing faster and lower than POR 25682 and established a windward overlap at a lateral distance of 2 m between the hulls.
ITA 4149 passed POR 25682 to windward and when the boats were overlapped bow to bow, ITA 4149 was heeled to leeward further than POR 25682.
POR 25682, being blanketed by ITA 4149 heeled less so that the distance between the rigs was less than 2 m.
POR 25682 bore away slightly and ITA 4149 passed her to windward.
conclusions: ITA 4149 to windward failed to keep clear of POR 25682 to leeward, and broke RRS 11.
